Privacy policy
Close
Privacy: photo contribution
What is collected

Only if you turn contribution on: each analysed photo at full resolution with its EXIF metadata (GPS location unless you turn off “Include location”, date and time, phone make and model, orientation), the detected objects (class, box and confidence), the app version and an anonymous install ID (derived from a key that never leaves the phone). No name, account, e-mail or contacts.
What for
To improve the OceanGuard detection and species models and to compute statistics (for example where and when debris is found and with which phones). Nothing is sold or used for advertising.
Where it is kept

Each photo is encrypted on your phone so that only the private server of the OceanGuard research project can open it. It travels over HTTPS to a temporary buffer (Cloudflare, free plan) that only holds the encrypted copy, for at most 7 days, until the project server downloads it and deletes it there. The original photos with their EXIF are accessible only to the research team and are never served publicly.
What may be published
A research dataset may be published with the photos stripped of all EXIF and location, and their annotations. Real locations are never published, nor the install ID or the phone model.
How to withdraw

Turn contribution off in Settings to stop sending. “Delete my contributed photos” deletes from the server everything this phone sent. You can also ask the project to do it, giving the anonymous contributor ID shown in Settings.
Licence

By contributing you agree that your photos and their annotations may be shared, without EXIF or location, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0), credited to “OceanGuard AI contributors”.
